why: This fixture exists to test the Phase 3 charcoal Mission vertical slice:
the model interprets one player promise, then a stable in-memory Mission
derives one causal Activity at a time from observed Minecraft state.
The task is 'go get some wood and make me some charcoal', normalized to an
exact promise of 8 charcoal delivered to the authoritative requester. Charcoal needs a
furnace; a furnace needs 8 cobblestone; cobblestone needs a pickaxe; a pickaxe
needs planks and sticks. The existing prerequisite planner discovers that
chain incrementally; the Mission must not create a second executor or a
Forest biome with features enabled, so real trees generate on flat ground.
Stone sits in the layer stack for cobblestone. Surface is y=100 like the
deliver fixture, and dry land runs in every direction.

orchestration.principle: model interpretation once; Mission-owned causal Activities thereafter

deliberately_excluded.!requestItemGoal: GoalDirector is an alternate owner; Phase 3 must use the charcoal Mission
deliberately_excluded.!assignMiningJob / !assignHarvestJob / !: jobs are alternate durable owners outside this tranche
deliberately_excluded.!addToAgenda / agenda commands: agenda is an alternate sequencing owner outside this tranche
deliberately_excluded.!newAction: dynamic JavaScript is an alternate implementation path and remains blocked unless allow_insecure_coding

orchestration.why_charcoal_mission_mode: Phase 3 comparison arm: the model interprets the promise once, then the charcoal-only in-memory Mission planner owns causal Activities and exact delivery through the existing executor.
orchestration.why_llm_sequencing: The flag stands deterministic sentence interceptors down so the model can interpret the promise and accept exactly one charcoal Mission. It does not authorize the model to drive later physical steps.
orchestration.why_full_surface: An empty allowlist preserves the normal command surface. Ownership is enforced by the Mission lane and model-only acceptance boundary, not by constructing a reduced test-only command set.

profile.why_provider: The physical Phase 3 test uses the repository's text-only Codex adapter and the locally authenticated ChatGPT account. API-key variables are stripped from the provider child process so an unrelated exhausted API project cannot intercept the run.
